question: Which of the following element has atomic number 12?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Mg.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The element with atomic number 12 is magnesium (Mg).**
 
• Magnesium is a** light, silvery-white metal that is abundant in the earth's crust.**
 
• It is commonly used in alloys with other metals, such as **aluminum, to improve strength and corrosion resistance.**
 
• Magnesium is also an essential element for living organisms, playing a key role in many biochemical reactions in the body.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: Oxygen (O) is a non-metallic element with atomic number 8. It is a colorless, odorless gas that makes up about 21% of the earth's atmosphere.
 
• Option 3: Helium (c) is a noble gas with atomic number 2. It is the second lightest element and is commonly used in balloons and as a cooling agent in MRI machines.
 
• Option 4: Magnesium (Mg) is a light, silvery-white metal with atomic number 12. It is commonly used in alloys and is essential for living organisms.
